description: This file contains the implementation of the SearchService interface, specifically the SearchServiceImpl class, which handles search indexing, deletion, and querying functionalities for products within a sales management system. It interacts with an external search service (possibly Elasticsearch) and deals with indexing products, deleting indices, and performing search operations with keyword auto-complete and faceted search features.

classes.name: SearchServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing search indexing and retrieval operations for products, including indexing new products, deleting product indices, and executing search queries with support for auto-complete and faceted search.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Initializes the external search service component.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a product into the search system using product details and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteIndex
methods.description: Removes a product from the search index based on its descriptions and store details.

methods.name: searchForKeywords
methods.description: Performs an auto-complete or keyword suggestion search based on a JSON query and returns matching keywords.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query for products within a store and language, returning results with highlights, facets, and metadata.
